tasks.CalculateEligibleVoters: Calculate the number of eligible voters out of 5000 total voters where 20% are not eligible to vote.
tasks.CalculateWinningMarginVotes: Calculate the votes won by the winning candidate based on a margin of 15% from the total number of eligible voters.
tasks.DetermineTotalVotesForWinner: Determine the total number of votes the winning candidate got.
